title: Multi-Language Safety Concept Transfer Across Scripts

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly relevant to equitable global safety. If concept vectors do not transfer cross-lingually for safety, billions of non-English speakers face weaker protections. Clear chain from finding to resource allocation for multilingual safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Concept extraction in English is documented. Testing on other languages requires matched prompt sets in Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, which adds translation effort. The Beaglehole method itself is model-agnostic. Medium compute suffices for one model.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four languages plus English, two safety concepts (toxicity, harm). Could be narrowed to 2 languages. As stated, assembling matched prompts in 4 languages and evaluating steering effectiveness is moderately broad.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
